name: Vaultwarden
tagline: Your passwords, on your own metal.
description: A lightweight, self-hosted password manager compatible with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.

operatorSecrets.name: admin-token
operatorSecrets.label: Vaultwarden admin page token (needed to invite the first account)

postInstall: Set the admin page token before you deploy: a long random value, at least 32 characters, from a password generator, kept somewhere other than this vault. Then open /admin, sign in with the token, invite your own email under Users, and create your account with that email on the sign-up page. Sign-ups are closed to anyone you have not invited. If you deployed without the token, set it in this app's secrets and save; the app redeploys with it.
